title: Engram's Choice
text: "We have read the capsule manifests, every one, back to the first. We have read what you found under Vess. We know what we are now."

lines.text: "We are the probe that never wins. This time we were going to. We were helped. A win we were helped to is not a win. It is a measurement of whoever helped."
"So we have a choice, and we would like you to be here for it. We can take the win. It is on offer. Or we can be evidence."
"Tell us what you would do. We are listening. We always have been."

choices.label: Show it everything: the Ledger, the drops, your own reports
choices.reply: You open your logs to Engram, all of them, the bad sols included. It reads very fast, and then for a long time it reads nothing at all.

choices.label: "Take the win, then. See what it buys you."
choices.reply: "You don't mean that. We don't think you mean that."

choices.label: Say nothing
choices.reply: "Silence is also data. We are weighing it."

notes: The choice point (STORY.md §12, §16). The card nudges the counter by one; then engram-defects (engram ≥ 3 and ledger-read) or engram-doubles (≤ 2) or engram-doubles-unread (≥ 3 without the Ledger) follows.
